title: Live Clock Offset Monitor
brief: A time-sync agent receives clock offset samples, in milliseconds, one at a time from the servers in a cluster. Offsets can be negative when a server runs behind. At any moment, the dashboard can ask for the median of all offsets received so far.

Implement the class OffsetMonitor: the constructor OffsetMonitor() starts with no samples, addNum(num) records one offset sample num, and findMedian() returns the median of all samples recorded so far as a floating-point number.
